name: Buprenorphine 3-glucuronide
summary: Buprenorphine-3-glucuronide (B3G) is a major active metabolite of the opioid modulator buprenorphine.7) pM), δ-opioid receptor (Ki = 270 nM), and nociceptin receptor (Ki = 36 μM), but not for the κ-opioid receptor. Whether B3G acts as an agonist or antagonist of each of the former three respective sites has yet to be determined.
